name: Shooting instructor and range

pf.license.need: none checked by Rosie: a range needs no state license in most places; the business registration and the range's local permits are the owner's own word; where the state's rules require a training certificate for a class, the owner says so (a switch from the state form)
pf.license.who: the range for its registration and permits; each instructor for their own training certificate
pf.license.ask: optional: the registration number and any permit number the range wants shown; nothing is checked
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never checks a license, certificate, permit, insurance or background check (D96); the range keeps its own records
pf.license.blocks: nothing: no license or certificate blocks a booking here; the owner decides who may teach or staff a lane
pf.license.renewals: a reminder the owner sets for its own dates, if it wants one
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance is the range's own matter; optional for the booking
pf.license.background: any background or ownership check is the business's own step, outside Rosie; Rosie never checks it

pf.services.shape: a lane (indoor) or a bench (outdoor) booked by the hour like a space, with a range safety officer on duty; lessons book an instructor's time plus a lane; classes are seats on a timetable; flow B: an instructor's time at the customer's home or private land, and classroom seats at a host's place
pf.services.examples: the example range's own prices (Lee Shooting Range and Lee Shooting Lessons), not a standard

list.name: First-time shooter package
list.length: a safety briefing and a 1-hour lane lesson with an instructor
list.after: nothing more; range ammunition is bought at the counter, the range's own sale outside Rosie
list.needs: a range safety officer on duty for the lane, and a rental handgun if the shooter has none
list.note: one adult per package; a shooter under 18 comes with a parent who signs and stays on site for the whole visit

list.name: Indoor lane hour (supervised range time)
list.length: 1 hour on a lane with a range safety officer on duty
list.before: a card saved for the $15 no-show fee
list.note: a second shooter on the same lane adds $12 (example); lanes are supervised range time, not an empty room

list.name: Private lesson (1 hour)
list.length: 1 hour with an instructor on a lane
list.before: a card saved for the $25 late-cancel fee
list.after: the saved card is charged at DONE
list.needs: an instructor and a lane with a range safety officer on duty

list.name: Carry-permit class (a seat in a session)
list.length: 4 Saturdays, the hours the state's rules set
list.after: the $149 rest paid at the counter at the first class
list.capacity: 10 seats; runs with at least 4 by 7 days before
list.note: only where the state's rules require training for a permit (a switch from the state form); a certificate after the last class

list.name: Firearm rental (an add-on)
list.note: photo ID and the owner's age and eligibility rules at the counter; rental firearms never leave the range

list.name: In-home safety and safe-storage lesson (flow B)
list.before: a card saved for the $40 fee
list.after: the saved card is charged at DONE
list.note: no live fire and no ammunition in the room; the instructor checks each firearm is unloaded and safely stored

list.name: Private coaching on the customer's land (flow B, 4 visits)
list.where: at the customer's land, with the owner's written OK
list.after: the $450 rest on the bill after the last visit
list.note: a cleared instructor only; the land's owner must OK it in writing (Sam asks)

list.name: Classroom safety course seat at a host's place (flow B)
list.length: 3 hours, classroom only, no live fire

pf.services.capacity: one instructor per lesson; a lane shows a time only when the instructor and a range safety officer are both free; a range safety officer is on duty for every open lane
pf.services.goods: ammunition, targets and gear are the business's own sale at the counter, outside Rosie; Rosie books services only
pf.services.online: classroom theory may be by video where the state allows it; lanes and lessons never
pf.services.outOfScope: renting a lane or a range by the hour with no instruction or staff is renting a space for a time, which Rosie doesn't book (Jay, Oct 24); lanes are booked only as supervised range time

beforeTimes: new to shooting, or experienced (new shooters get the package or a lesson, and the safety briefing)
how many shooters, and the age of each (sets the lane and who may come)
a rental firearm, or their own
for flow B: a home or private land, and the town
afterTime: anything the instructor should know (left-handed, a past injury that affects grip)
securePage: the waiver and the range rules, signed by each shooter (a parent signs for anyone under 18)
the date of birth of each shooter (age limits)
for a rental: a yes that the renter isn't barred by the federal or state rules from having a firearm (a switch)
for flow B at home: that every firearm will be unloaded with ammunition stored in another room, and where children are during the lesson
for flow B on private land: that the customer owns or may use the land, that shooting is allowed there, and the backstop
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian books for anyone under 18 and shoots on the same lane; nobody under 8 on the firing line (the range's rule)

stop.words: someone shot or hurt now, a firearm accident, a threat to hurt someone
stop.say: Call 911 now. Get to a safe place.

stop.words: words about ending one's life or hurting oneself
stop.booking: no booking in that chat; staff are told privately, with no words passed on

goOn.words: pregnant, or bringing a young child to an indoor range
goOn.what: the booking goes on; the range's own note about lead and noise is shown; Rosie gives no medical advice

goOn.words: a hearing or heart condition, a recent surgery on the hands, arms or shoulders
goOn.what: the booking goes on; it's noted privately for the instructor

pf.safety.sobriety: nobody who seems drunk or high shoots that day
pf.safety.rental: a rental firearm is never given to someone alone and visibly upset; staff decide privately, and nothing is said in a text
pf.safety.range: eye and ear protection for everyone on the range; the range safety officer's commands come first; a cease-fire stops every lane
pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Waiver and range rules
steps.when: signed on the secure page while booking
steps.who: every shooter; a parent or guardian signs for anyone under 18
steps.result: signed: it books; not signed: no shooting until it's signed at the counter

steps.name: Safety briefing
steps.when: at the counter at the start of a shooter's first visit, 15 minutes
steps.result: done: the shooter goes to the lane; not able to follow the range rules: no shooting today

steps.name: Photo ID
steps.when: at the counter, every visit with a rental
steps.result: shows the right age: the rental goes ahead; none: no rental today

steps.name: Barred-person yes for a rental
steps.when: on the secure page while booking
steps.who: every renter, where the federal and state rules apply (a switch)
steps.result: a yes: it books; a no: no rental, told kindly, the reason never texted

steps.name: Home or land checklist (flow B)
steps.when: on the secure page while booking
steps.result: all yes: it books; a no: the instructor calls before anything is booked

pf.first_steps.prep: bring a photo ID; wear closed-toe shoes and a crew-neck top (hot brass); no alcohol before; arrive 15 minutes early for the briefing; bring your own firearm unloaded and cased

pf.visit.checkIn: at the counter: the check-in code, the photo ID for a rental, the waiver on file, and the safety briefing for a first visit; the class roster for classes; at the customer's home or land (flow B): the code at the door
pf.visit.beforeWork: the range safety officer assigns the lane and checks eye and ear protection; at a home, the instructor checks every firearm used is unloaded and the ammunition is in another room before the lesson
pf.visit.changes: more lane time only if the next booking allows, priced first; a cease-fire or lightning stops shooting; a lesson stopped for safety is done another way or moved
pf.visit.done: the check-in code, or the instructor's DONE; the rental firearms are checked back in before the shooter leaves
pf.visit.children: a shooter under 18 is always on the same lane as their parent or guardian; never left

pf.money.before: a first-time package and a class seat are paid in full, or a class takes a deposit with the rest at the first class; lanes and lessons save a card for the fee; a series' deposit is taken when booked
pf.money.after: lanes are paid at the counter, or the saved card is charged at DONE for private lessons and the in-home lesson; the rest of a series on the bill after the last visit
pf.money.caps: deposit cap: from the state form; prepaid training money kept apart where the state's rules require it
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel until 24 hours before (the owner's setting); a weather or range-closed cancel by the range is always free
pf.money.fees: late cancel or no-show: $25 (example), $15 for a lane, $40 at home, only with the owner's OK, and never more than what was paid now; never for weather, a range closure, or a shooter who says before the visit that they aren't fit to shoot. A shooter turned away for their own reason (impaired, refuses a safety rule, or gave an answer that wasn't true) is treated like a no-show: any fee is the owner's call.
pf.money.membership: charged monthly to the saved card after the membership's own yes; cancel with 30 days' notice (the example's terms) or as the state's rules require
pf.money.refunds: a lesson or lane the range cancels is never charged; unused classes refunded under the course terms
pf.money.tax: where the state's rules tax the range's sales or services
pf.money.fee2: Rosfield's $2 applies: one $2 per confirmed booking; a series counts once
pf.money.goods: ammunition, targets, eye and ear protection and range gear are the range's own sale at the counter, outside Rosie

pf.messages.never: whether someone owns firearms, which ones, serial numbers, permit numbers, the barred-person answer, health notes and any crisis words never go in a text: only the secure page
pf.messages.staffTexts: texts to staff name the customer, the lane or class and the time only
pf.messages.neutral: texts name the business, the date, the time and the lane or class, nothing about firearms
pf.messages.minors: a minor's texts go to the parent or guardian

pf.staff.licenses: each instructor's training certificate and ratings are the range's own word, shown to the owner; not checked by Rosie (D96)
pf.staff.skills: range safety officer, handgun instructor, rifle instructor, carry-permit instructor, youth instructor, in-home safety lessons
pf.staff.supervision: a range safety officer on duty for every open lane; at most 6 lanes per range safety officer (the range's rule)
pf.staff.oks: the owner OKs fees, refunds and private-land lessons; the range safety officer may stop anyone from shooting
pf.staff.standIn: a lesson's instructor may be replaced only by one with the same skill, offered first, never assumed; a class's instructor by one with the same certification
pf.staff.away: only instructors cleared by the owner teach at homes or on private land
pf.staff.certificates: each instructor's certificate end date, if the range enters one: a reminder for the owner only

pf.rules.age: minimum ages for using and renting firearms on the range follow the federal and state rules and the range's own stricter rule (switches)
pf.rules.barred: rentals only to people the federal and state rules allow to have a firearm (a switch)
pf.rules.carry: a carry-permit class only where the state's rules call for one, taught as the state's form says
pf.rules.lead: lead and air rules for indoor ranges (switches from the state and local forms)
pf.rules.childAccess: child-access and safe-storage rules where the state has them, taught in the home lesson (a switch)
pf.rules.records: waivers, briefing records and rental logs kept as the state asks, and at least 7 years
pf.rules.security: a shooter's eligibility (age and any legal bar) is the range's own check at the counter, on the shooter's own yes on the secure page; Rosie never checks a document (D96)
pf.rules.scope: instructors don't give legal advice on carrying or storage; the state's rules set what's taught, where the state's rules require it

pf.edges.impaired: a shooter who seems impaired: no shooting that day
pf.edges.noId: no photo ID for a rental: no rental today; the lane can still be used with their own firearm
pf.edges.alone: a first-time renter alone: a lesson instead, or come back with another adult
pf.edges.lightning: lightning within 10 miles: the outdoor range closes until 30 minutes after the last strike; bookings move indoors or to a new time with no fee
pf.edges.ceaseFire: a cease-fire stops every lane; time lost is added or refunded
pf.edges.hurt: someone hurt: cease-fire, first aid, 911; the owner told at once
pf.edges.minor: a minor: always on the same lane as the parent or guardian
pf.edges.late: a late shooter: the lane time ends when booked
pf.edges.full: all lanes busy: the next open lane, or the waitlist
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way

notes:
Built Oct 27 by Haiku builder C4 from driving-school (refitted, 0/0) and the Oct 24 shooting sample plug-in (verified gaps kept in work/gaps/shooting.json).
Lanes are supervised range time with a range safety officer on duty, not an empty room (Jay removed renting a space for a time on Oct 24). Flagged for Jay and the verifier: if lane-only booking is out, the lane path (card|counter) goes and the rest stays.
Paths A: full|none first-time shooter package ($89, paid in full; fee $25); card|counter indoor lane hour ($25, fee $15, paid at the counter); card|card 1-hour private lesson ($95, fee $25, DONE); deposit|counter carry-permit class ($199: $50 deposit, $149 rest at the counter at the first class).
Paths B: card|card in-home safety and safe-storage lesson ($120, fee $40, DONE; no live fire, no ammunition in the room); full|none classroom seat at a host's place ($45, fee $20); deposit|bill private coaching on the customer's land ($600 over 4 visits: $150 deposit, $450 rest on the bill after the last visit; owner's written OK).
Minors: a shooter under 18 always has a parent or guardian on site, who signs (A8-67 'a child may be left' off; B8-67 child-in-care off). Under 10 is not booked (the example's setting; the owner sets it).
Ages and eligibility for a handgun or rifle rental: the federal and state rules and the range's own rule, shown as generic words with no number from any state; the shooter's own yes on the secure page; the counter decides. Rosie never checks a document (D96).
D96: no range registration, permit, instructor certificate or background check is checked by Rosie; S1-60 off, S2-28 off, D96 steps off, words on S1-60/S1-61/S2-28/S2-29.
D97: the $2 applies (S1-62 off). S2-30 sent now off. S1-71 health agreement off (not health care). Sensitive OFF (no health words in the work; the verifier may decide).
Impaired or refused-rule shooter: treated like a no-show, the owner's call (test-drive gap, A8-51 shop's side; not fixed in the master).
Splits kept: S1-80 (lanes are spaces), A4-43 (the waiver and range rules per shooter), A4-66, A7-59, A7-15, A7-63, A7-68, A8-02, S11-87, S11-90; B: S1-80, B4-78, B5-34, B7-62, S11-87, S11-90.
Not sure (verifier): the land-coaching series (B) puts live firearms on a private land: the steps are thin and need the verifier's eye; the carry-permit class names 'a switch from the state form' but no switch is live, so it runs as an example class.
